title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: DevOps Pleno/Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico e desafiador, com atividades que envolvem desde o desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas, até a manutenção de infraestrutura cloud.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos. Incluindo atividades como:

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes de infraestrutura cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou Azure Resource Manager.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, automatizando processos de integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras e de configuração.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no processo de entrega de software e implementação de otimizações.
  • Resolver incidentes e problemas de produção de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a estabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar-se efetivamente com outras áreas da empresa.


Resultados esperados incluem a otimização do tempo de desenvolvimento, a redução do tempo de lançamento de nova versões em produção e a melhoria contínua do processo de entrega de software. Exemplos de entregáveis incluem a configuração e manutenção de ambientes de infraestrutura cloud, o desenvolvimento de scripts de automação de tarefas e pipelines de CI/CD, além da resolução de incidentes e problemas de produção.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência com plataformas de orquestração de containers, como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou Openshift
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração, como Ansible, Puppet e Chef
  • Experiência em linguagens de programação, como Python, Ruby ou Go, para automatizar tarefas e desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e metodologias ágeis
  • Familiaridade com infraestruturas cloud, como AWS, Azure ou GCP
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Observabilidade) e gerenciamento de LOGs, como Datadog, NewRelic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana e Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com a prática de infraestrutura como código, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation e/ou Azure Resource Manager para provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura cloud.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Senior Full Stack .NET Engineer
description:
About You

You are a senior full stack engineer who enjoy owning features end-to-end, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and shaping delivery processes rather than simply executing tasks. You are comfortable working with legacy systems while helping modernize platforms that support high-visibility sports and real-time event management applications.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ASP.NET Core and C# for building web applications and data APIs.
  • Proven experience using Entity Framework Core and LINQ for data access and business logic.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL Server , including writing complex queries and working with relational data models.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript , jQuery , and frontend development using MVC / Razor views .
  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs .
  • Exposure to real-time or event-driven features (e.g., SignalR or similar patterns).
  • General cloud literacy with exposure to Azure services such as Blob Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Azure AD.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern version control workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of Web Components (e.g., Shadow DOM / Light DOM).
  • Excellent communication skills, able to participate in weekly client-facing meetings with US-based teams.
  • English proficiency is required, as you will be working directly with US clients in the sports industry.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining ASP.NET Core web applications and data APIs that support real-time sports and event management platforms.
  • Implementing backend logic using C#, Entity Framework Core, and LINQ, ensuring clean, maintainable code.
  • Developing frontend functionality using JavaScript, jQuery, Web Components, and Razor / MVC.
  • Writing and maintaining SQL Server queries to support application features.
  • Integrating with Azure services such as Blob Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault, and Azure AD as part of the platform ecosystem.
  • Participating in code reviews and contributing to continuous improvement of development practices.
  • Owning the quality of your deliverables by writing unit and end-to-end tests for critical business logic.
  • Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in both development and production environments.
  • Acting as a trusted senior contributor, helping to scale processes, shape workflows, and ensure consistency, quality, and efficiency across projects.


Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework Core and SQL Server.
  • Proven experience developing frontend features using JavaScript, jQuery, and Razor / MVC views.
  • Senior delivery mindset with strong English communication skills.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Pricing or Computer Vision) 100% Remote, Fluent English (required)


Brazil-based | PJ Contract | Long-term


We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team on a long-term, fully remote PJ contract . This is a global environment with international stakeholders, and fluency in English is mandatory , as all communication and interviews are conducted in English.


This role is open to Brazil-based professionals with strong experience in Pricing/Optimization or Computer Vision , who are passionate about building and deploying production-grade ML systems that drive real business impact.


What you’ll do


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve complex business problems
  • Own key components of ML systems, influencing technical direction and architectural decisions
  • Develop clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to generate actionable insights
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies to build robust and scalable models
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders
  • Mentor junior team members and help grow domain expertise within the team
  • Contribute to the company’s technical leadership through research, publications, or patents


Minimum Requirements


  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s Degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Strong understanding of ML best practices (feature engineering, A/B testing, experiment design, training & serving pipelines)
  • Hands-on experience with ML algorithms and techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization)
  • Experience in at least one of the following domains:
  • Pricing / price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection & authentication, or marketing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with scientific and ML libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Solid data engineering experience with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with Big Data tools such as Spark, Kafka, Apache Beam
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure )
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world business problems, preferably in retail or e-commerce
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines
  • Strong sense of ownership, impact-driven mindset, and passion for high-quality ML solutions


Why join us

  • 100% remote work (Brazil-based)
  • Long-term PJ contract
  • Flexible working hours aligned with Brazil time
  • Opportunity to work on impactful ML systems in a global environment
  • Strong technical ownership and growth opportunities

title: Account Executive - B2B SaaS
description:
About the Role

We’re hiring high-performing B2B SaaS Account Executives based in LATAM who want full ownership of their number and unlimited earning potential.

This is a role for builders, not order-takers. You’ll own the entire sales cycle, work directly with US-based customers, and be rewarded on performance. If you believe sales is the fastest path to growth, autonomy, and income, this role is for you.


About Lilo

Lilo is rebuilding procurement for Commercial Real Estate using AI.

Hotels and CRE operators still manage procurement with emails, calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Lilo replaces that chaos with a single AI-powered platform that automates purchasing, vendor management, invoice processing, and price optimization.

We work with major hotel management companies and staple hotel brands in the US, and we’re in an explosive growth path. Top performers have outsized impact and ownership.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the entire outbound sales motion : prospecting, discovery, demo, close with US-based customers
  • Represent Lilo at industry events and network your way to high profile decision makers
  • Build and manage a pipeline of C-level operators, hotel owners, and decision-makers
  • Navigate consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Work closely with onboarding and product to ensure long-term customer success


What We’re Looking For

  • Excellent written and spoken English (C2 level)
  • Up to 5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales (closing role, not SDR-only)
  • Proven track record owning full sales cycles
  • Strong outbound prospecting skills (email, LinkedIn, calls)
  • Experience selling to US-based customers
  • Comfortable working remotely with high independence
  • Competitive, performance-driven mindset


Compensation & Upside

  • Base salary: US$2,500/Mo.
  • On Target Commission: $2,500+/Mo. (50/50 split)
  • Total OTE: $5,000+/Mo.
  • Uncapped commissions + boosters
  • ESOP package with high potential upside

The harder you grind, the more you make.


Who Should NOT Apply

This role is not for you if:

  • You are not confident selling in English to US customers
  • You want a passive, inbound-only sales role
  • You need heavy structure, scripts, or constant supervision
  • You’re uncomfortable picking up the phone, doing outbound outreach, and rejection
  • You’re looking for a slow-moving, corporate environment


Why Lilo?

  • Fully remote role with a fast-growing, US-based startup
  • USD compensation with uncapped upside
  • Direct exposure to high profile US-based customers
  • Fast-moving startup with real ownership and accountability
  • Early-stage opportunity with real revenue ownership and ESOP upside
  • Performance-first compensation with uncapped upside
  • Ambitious, low-ego, execution-focused team
  • Exposure to AI, SaaS, and hospitality at scale

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.


It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.



Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (Node.js/TypeScript)
description:
Quem somos?


Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto - SP, com a missão de tornar as organizações da saúde mais eficientes, possibilitando a melhor assistência aos pacientes. Queremos ser reconhecidos como uma das maiores provedoras de serviços de informações a operadores de saúde!


No nosso ambiente de trabalho, procuramos sempre agir com base nos nossos valores. É através deles que chegaremos mais perto de alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Pense grande;
  • Excelente não é suficiente;
  • Fail fast, learn faster;
  • Inovar para revolucionar;
  • Simples sempre;
  • Só é bom pra gente se for bom pro cliente;


Qual o desafio?


Buscamos uma pessoa com visão arquitetural e experiência em alta escalabilidade para elevar o nível técnico do nosso time. Você terá papel fundamental na definição de padrões de engenharia e na construção de sistemas robustos que impactam diretamente a eficiência do setor de saúde.


O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?


Sua missão vai além de escrever código: você será uma referência técnica dentro da Carefy.


  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.


Qual o contexto?


Você fará parte do nosso time de integração. Somos os responsáveis pela interoperabilidade da Carefy. Nossa missão é conectar nossa plataforma aos ecossistemas heterogêneos das operadoras de saúde, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance. Neste time, você atuará como referência técnica : participando diretamente do desenho de soluções junto aos times de TI dos clientes e, internamente, traduzindo esses desafios complexos em uma arquitetura limpa e em demandas organizadas para orientar o desenvolvimento.


O que esperamos de você?


  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de enxergar o impacto de uma decisão técnica em todo o ecossistema do produto.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade de negociar soluções técnicas com clientes externos e guiar o time interno com clareza.
  • Autonomia com Responsabilidade: Habilidade para tocar projetos complexos com pouca supervisão, gerenciando riscos.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz e em soluções definitivas.


Quais são os requisitos?


  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem e otimização;
  • Experiência comprovada com Arquitetura de Software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD);
  • Experiência prática com Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e serviços de Mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka) ;
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs RESTful escaláveis;
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta criticidade e volume de dados;
  • Domínio de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.js ;
  • Conhecimento prático em testes automatizados (TDD , testes unitários e de integração);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


Será um diferencial:


  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


O que oferecemos?


  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!


Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes (Home Office)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to work remotely for one of our clients. This is a role with a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.


Job location: Remote, work anywhere from Brazil.


This job requires excellent English, written and spoken. Please submit a resume in English and be prepared for English language interviews throughout the process.


The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes platforms across Lab, Non-Prod, and Production environments. The Kubernetes Engineer works cross‑functionally with cloud, cybersecurity, compute, network, and application teams to deliver resilient and automated platform services aligned with Product Management and CCOE strategies


Key Responsibilities :

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate Kubernetes clusters (on‑prem and/or cloud) following standard reference architectures.
  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes add‑ons, CSI storage drivers, CNI network plugins, and ingress controllers.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Perform lifecycle upgrades of Kubernetes, OS, infrastructure software (GKE, Rancher), and supporting components.
  • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.
  • Manage hardware lifecycle work for Kubernetes‑backed compute environments.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning solutions. In this role, you will influence the technical direction of the team, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners, and drive innovation across data-driven initiatives.

title: Azure Windows Solutions Architect
description:
Lead Azure & Windows Infrastructure Architect (POD 1 & 2)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 13+ Years | Level: C5/C6 (Senior Leadership)

The Challenge

Are you a master of Windows ecosystems ready to lead the charge into the Cloud? We are looking for a Lead Infrastructure Architect to spearhead large-scale migrations for high-stakes industries like Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

In this role, you aren’t just a designer—you are the General of our Cloud PODs. You will lead a technical team of 5+ engineers, ensuring that complex legacy environments are modernized, secured, and migrated to Azure with surgical precision.

Your Impact

  • Architectural Sovereignty: Design the end-to-end \"Target State\" for massive enterprise environments. You will own the HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) , ensuring every VM, Cluster, and Network packet has its place.
  • Lead the Squad: Act as the technical North Star for a team of 5+ infra experts. You will guide, govern, and mentor your team to deliver excellence under pressure.
  • Windows Modernization: You are the expert who knows Windows Clustering, DFS, and File/Print Services inside out. You’ll be the one to solve the \"impossible\" legacy issues during migration.
  • The Business Brain: You don't just build; you justify. You’ll use TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI metrics to prove to stakeholders that your architecture is the most efficient and cost-effective solution.
  • Mission Critical Support: You will oversee the stability of the environment, ensuring 24/7 reliability through robust Backup, DR, and Monitoring solutions.

What You Bring to the Table

  • The Veteran Background: 13+ years in IT with a deep focus on Windows Server and Azure IaaS/PaaS .
  • Migration Mastery: Expert-level experience with Azure Migrate for server consolidation and workload shifts.
  • Networking & Identity Guru: Deep knowledge of DNS, DHCP, WINS, and Azure IAM/Key Vault to keep our Landing Zones secure and connected.
  • Resilience Expert: Hands-on experience with Windows Clustering and Azure Site Recovery (ASR) for business continuity.
  • Strategic Communicator: You can navigate a 24x7 shift environment, manage customer calls with poise, and present complex solutions to C-suite stakeholders.

The Toolkit

  • Core: Azure Infrastructure, Windows Server (all versions), Azure Networking.
  • Leadership: Team Management & Technical Governance.
  • Compliance: Experience in regulated domains (SIAM, Data Privacy, Financial regulations).
  • Certifications (Preferred): AZ-305 (Solutions Architect Expert) or AZ-104 .

Why This Role?

This is more than a migration job; it’s a leadership opportunity. You will own the strategy for POD 1 and 2 , deciding how global enterprises evolve. If you enjoy solving complex \"under-the-hood\" Windows issues while simultaneously designing high-level cloud strategies, this is your next career move.

Ready to lead the migration? Apply now and let’s build the future of Enterprise Cloud.

What makes this version effective?

  • Directly addresses the \"POD\" structure: It makes the candidate feel like they are leading a specific mission.
  • Highlights the Hybrid nature: It acknowledges that they need to be good at both the new (Azure) and the old (Windows Clustering/DFS).
  • Emphasizes Leadership: By using words like \"General\" and \"North Star,\" you attract people who want to manage teams, not just configurations.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Azure SQL Solutions Architect (Level P5/P6/P7)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 15+ Years | Sector: Enterprise Cloud Transformation

The Mission

Are you a visionary architect who lives at the intersection of Data and Infrastructure ? We are looking for a heavy-hitter to lead massive, high-stakes cloud migrations for some of the world’s largest brands in Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

As our SQL Architect , you aren't just moving databases; you are reimagining how global enterprises operate in the cloud. You will be the technical authority responsible for auditing complex legacy environments and architecting the future-state of Azure Data & Infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect the Future: Conduct deep-dive \"AS-IS\" assessments and design sophisticated \"Target State\" architectures that get approved by executive review boards.
  • Lead the Migration: Drive large-scale Azure migration activities, utilizing Azure Migrate to move complex on-prem workloads to the cloud.
  • Master the Landing Zone: Design and build secure, scalable Azure Landing Zones from the ground up, ensuring identity (IAM), security (Key Vault), and governance are baked-in.
  • Blueprint Excellence: Produce high-fidelity HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) documents covering the entire Azure ecosystem.
  • Be the Expert: Provide technical leadership in troubleshooting deep-stack issues (Networking, IO, Clusters) and define the BoM (Bill of Materials) to ensure clients get maximum value for their investment.

What We’re Looking For

  • The Veteran: 15+ years of IT experience, with at least a decade dedicated to the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
  • The SQL Specialist: Deep, hands-on mastery of Azure SQL (IaaS & PaaS) , Azure Storage, and high-availability data solutions.
  • The Strategist: Experience in Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BCDR) and infrastructure-as-code principles.
  • The Communicator: Ability to bridge the gap between deep technical troubleshooting and C-suite stakeholder management.
  • The Industry Expert: Previous success navigating the regulatory complexities of the Banking or Healthcare sectors.

Technical Toolkit

  • Primary: Azure SQL, Azure Migrate, IAM, Key Vault, Storage.
  • Architecture: Mastery of Frameworks (TOGAF or similar), HLD/LLD creation.
  • Certification (The Cherry on Top): AZ-305 (Infrastructure Solutions) or AZ-104 (Administrator).

Why Join Us?

You will work on projects of massive scale where your designs directly impact the security and efficiency of global financial and medical data. This is a role for an architect who wants to own the \"Big Picture\" while staying sharp on the technical details.

Ready to build the next generation of Cloud Infrastructure? Let’s talk.

title: Product Owner
description:

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.

Implementation & Technical Support

System Optimization & Scaling

Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


The Controller is a hands-on, strategic finance leader responsible for overseeing all accounting operations across the company. This role ensures accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and scalable processes to support a growing, multi-brand food business.


The Controller partners closely with leadership to provide financial insights, manage cash flow, and support operational decision-making in a fast-moving CPG environment. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable operating at both the transactional and strategic levels.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:


Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process for all entities
  • Prepare and review timely and accurate financial statements including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
  • Ensure proper revenue recognition, inventory accounting, COGS, and accruals
  • Maintain and enforce consistent accounting policies and procedures
  • Manage the chart of accounts and general ledger structure to support brand-level and customer-level analysis


Inventory, Costing & Manufacturing Finance

  • Oversee inventory accounting for raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods
  • Ensure accurate standard costing and variance analysis across materials, labor, and overhead
  • Partner with Operations to reconcile production, yields, and inventory movements
  • Drive accuracy and functionality of ERP systems, including Katana
  • Monitor and analyze margins by SKU, customer, and sales channel


Cash Flow, AP/AR & Controls

  • Manage cash flow forecasting and short- and medium-term liquidity planning
  • Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
  • Improve working capital efficiency including inventory turns, DSO, and DPO
  • Implement and maintain strong internal controls and approval workflows
  • Manage vendor payments, ACH and check processes, and banking relationships


Systems, Process & Scale

  • Own and optimize accounting systems and integrations including QuickBooks, ERP (Katana), and bill-pay tools
  • Improve automation, documentation, and repeatable finance processes
  • Prepare the finance function for audit readiness and future growth
  • Partner on system upgrades, implementations, and reporting enhancements


Compliance & External Relationships

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and applicable tax and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external CPA firms on tax filings, reviews, and audits
  • Support state and federal reporting requirements as applicable
  • Assist with insurance, sales tax, and other compliance areas


Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Manage and develop accounting staff or external resources as the business grows
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain to provide financial insights
  • Deliver clear financial analysis to support pricing, promotions, and customer strategy
  • Act as a trusted financial thought partner to the CEO and leadership team


What We’re Looking For:


  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • CPA preferred but not required
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience
  • Experience in CPG, food and beverage, manufacturing, or inventory-heavy businesses strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of inventory accounting, costing, and margin analysis
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks and ERP systems
  • Katana experience is a strong plus
  • Proven ability to build and scale processes in a growing or entrepreneurial environment
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

CloudHive is your North America and LATAM Snowflake-focused staffing partner. We help accelerate Snowflake adoption and maximize the value of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud by delivering experienced, on-demand Snowflake contractors and specialized talent acquisition services.

  • Excellent communication skills for stakeholder collaboration.


Please get in touch for more information. Strictly no third parties.

title: Product Owner
description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Organizar junto as áreas, o desenvolvimento dos produtos e serviços alinhados à estratégia do negócio, com o objetivo de definir e priorizar os requisitos do produto e garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades dos usuários e do negócio. Atuar como um representante dos stakeholders (partes interessadas) e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o time de desenvolvimento para garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades do cliente e do negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Analisar, interpretar e construir a documentação e informações de sistemas compreendendo processos e regras de negócio mapeados, contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução para atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes;
  • Mapear, refinar e documentar regras de negócio, requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, histórias de usuário relativas ao produto;
  • Contextualizar funcionalidades e sistemas à processos e regras de negócio, demonstrando análise crítica e empenho no seu esclarecimento para suportar sua correta implementação;
  • Ser capaz de mapear os pontos de integração da solução e dos processos;
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;
  • Conduzir o entendimento do problema e definição da solução (processo de discovery: entender, alinhar e comunicar o objetivo do produto) de propostas complexas, de acordo com os critérios de aceite do cliente;
  • Elaborar, priorizar e manter atualizado o roadmap e realizar o gerenciamento e refinamento do backlog de desenvolvimento do projeto/produto.;
  • Construção de fluxos e prototipos de baixa fidelidade;
  • Garantir o entendimento do time de desenvolvimento referente aos itens do backlog do produto;
  • Conduzir os ritos da metodologia utilizada para desenvolvimento do produto (por exemplo ritos do Scrum: Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Retrospectiva etc.);
  • Realizar o controle de Burn down do projeto;
  • Garantir que os clientes internos e externos estejam alinhados quanto aos prazos e entregas;
  • Acompanhamento, homologação e reporte das entregas;
  • Reporte de informações do projeto a Gerência de Operações e/ou Gerente de Projetos a fim de subsidiar as decisões estratégicas;
  • Identificar e endereçar oportunidades de evolução do produto, para melhor atender as necessidades dos usuários;
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação e compliance estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação :

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e escrita clara, objetiva e organizada;
  • Capacidade de atuar com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de validação das especificações.
  • Conhecimento em acompanhamento e controle de indicadores (KPIs).


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de prototipação;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Vega (Tecnologia da Informação ou Agronegócio);
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de apoio para ideação, especificação, prototipação e validação de sistemas;
  • Mapeamento de processos;
  • Metodologias ágeis (exemplo: Framework Scrum etc);
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento sobre o CAR (Cadastro Ambiental Rural).


Informações adicionais

Por que escolher a VEGA?


Modelo de Trabalho Moderno:

Trabalho 100% Remoto ou Híbrido, se você estiver próximo à nossa sede (São José dos Campos) ou hubs (Lavras e Piracicaba).

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O ambiente é altamente tecnológico, com foco em arquitetura escalável , microsserviços , cloud computing e integrações corporativas , incluindo SAP . Os projetos são estratégicos, desenvolvidos em um contexto ágil, colaborativo e com impacto direto em soluções utilizadas em larga escala.

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

description:

Who are You ?


You are relentlessly committed to delivering exceptional partner support, combining deep technical knowledge with sharp analytical skills to resolve issues efficiently and prevent them from recurring. You excel at interpreting data, logs, and system behavior to uncover root causes and provide clear, actionable insights to both partners and internal teams.


A confident and influential communicator, you build strong relationships with operators, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. You thrive on translating complex technical details into understandable guidance, ensuring that partners always feel supported and informed.


Where you Fit In:


We are seeking a proactive and technically strong B2B Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of the iGaming industry and your strong analytical mindset to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues reported by our operators and internal stakeholders.


Working closely with the ITSM department — and reporting directly to the Technical Support Team Lead — you will be a key player in ensuring high-quality, timely support. Your ability to interpret logs, analyze platform behavior, communicate clearly, and escalate effectively will help maintain platform reliability and deliver an exceptional partner experience.


You will thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, technical curiosity, and a commitment to service excellence are essential. Your work will be pivotal in strengthening partner trust, improving operational stability, and supporting our mission to deliver a seamless and compliant gaming experience worldwide.


The impact you will have:


  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for B2B operators, platform partners, and integrators, ensuring their issues are resolved quickly, accurately, and with minimal business impact.

  • Stay current with industry standards, emerging technologies, and best practices across iGaming, payments, and platform operations, recommending improvements to processes and tooling.

What we’re looking for:


  • Experience in B2B Technical Support within the Casino or iGaming sector.

  • Experience working with logs, monitoring tools, and debugging complex integration issues.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, partners, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience with common support tooling (ex: Jira, Grafana, Kibana, etc.).


This role is remote and based in Brazil.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management.   • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful

Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: GenAI Solution Architect
description:
GenAI Solution Architect

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Full Time


In this role, you will:

  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
